question: Which is the heaviest and most powerful communication satellite of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**GSAT-11**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **GSAT-11** is the heaviest and most powerful communication satellite of India.
 
• It was launched by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) on December 5, 2018.
 
• GSAT-11 is part of the GSAT series of geostationary satellites and is designed to provide high data rate connectivity.
 
• The satellite weighs about 5,854 kg and is equipped with 40 transponders in the Ku-band and Ka-band frequencies.
 
• GSAT-11 aims to provide high-speed internet connectivity in remote areas and support the Digital India initiative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ISRO** is the space agency of the Government of India, headquartered in Bengaluru.
 
• ISRO's vision is to "harness space technology for national development while pursuing space science research & planetary exploration."
 
• ISRO has successfully launched a variety of satellites for different applications, including communication, earth observation, navigation, and scientific exploration.
 
• GSAT-11 is a significant milestone in ISRO's efforts to enhance India's satellite communication capabilities.
 
• Other notable satellites in the GSAT series include GSAT-19 and GSAT-29, which also aim to improve communication infrastructure in the country.
